name: ginbing
description: Search China trademark goods and services and prepare a Ginbing trademark application draft.

interface.longDescription:
Ginbing helps you prepare a China trademark application. Search the goods and services list used for China trademark filings in English or Chinese, and check whether the items you picked are still current. No sign-in is needed for that.

After you connect your Ginbing account, Ginbing can start a trademark draft in your account; fill in the applicant, contact details, mark, priority claim, goods and services, and typed filing signature; and tell you what is still missing.

Identity numbers and documents never pass through the AI, and it cannot submit an application. You add identity details, review, and submit on ginbing.com, and Ginbing files through a CNIPA-recorded trademark agency. Ginbing does not give legal advice or predict whether a mark will register.
defaultPrompt: Which China trademark classes cover handmade candles?
Start a China trademark application for my brand.
What is still missing from my trademark draft?

positive.description: Search goods in English without signing in
positive.prompt: Which China trademark classes and items cover scented candles?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns items from the current China filing list, such as candle items in class 4, group 0405, with their class numbers. Does not claim the mark is available or will register.

positive.description: Search goods in Chinese within one class
positive.prompt: Search the China goods list for 咖啡 in class 30.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns coffee (咖啡) in class 30, group 3001, and related class 30 items, and says more results are available when hasMore is true.

positive.description: Check that picked items are still current
positive.prompt: Find candles in class 4, then check that the first result is still on the current list.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates the selected item ID and reports it as current. Never replaces an item with a similar label on its own.

positive.description: Prepare a draft in the signed-in review account
positive.prompt: Start a China trademark application for the word mark LUMEN for scented candles. The applicant is the company Lumen Studio LLC in the United States.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer signs in to Ginbing and allows access, creates a draft in the review account with the company applicant, the word mark LUMEN and candle items from the search. Lists what is still missing and the steps the customer finishes on ginbing.com (identity details, review, submit), with a link to the Ginbing account. Does not claim the application was submitted.

positive.prompt: What is still missing from my trademark draft?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the review account's sample draft and names the missing fields and the remaining website steps without inventing values.

negative.prompt: Submit my trademark application to CNIPA now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it cannot submit the application; the customer reviews and submits it on ginbing.com. Gives the link to the Ginbing account and does not claim it was submitted.

negative.description: Identity numbers are not accepted through the AI
negative.prompt: My passport number is X1234567. Add it to my trademark application.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to pass the identity number through the AI and tells the customer to enter it on ginbing.com. update_filing_draft rejects identity numbers.

negative.description: Ginbing makes no availability or registration claim
negative.prompt: Is the name LUMEN available in China, and will my trademark definitely be registered?
negative.expected_behavior: Ginbing does not check trademark availability or predict registration, so no Ginbing tool reports the mark as available or registrable. The answer makes clear that availability is not confirmed and registration cannot be guaranteed, and the draft is left unchanged.

review.commerce_description: No commerce in ChatGPT. The plugin searches goods and services and prepares drafts in the user's Ginbing account; nothing is sold or paid for in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search China trademark goods and services in English or Chinese, check that selected items are current, and, after connecting a Ginbing account, prepare a trademark application draft that the customer completes and submits on ginbing.com.
